sig_fcbf12f92719f165318a.description: PSD Scotland intends to procure a Service Integration and Management contract for the transition, stabilisation and continued delivery of selected national digital services supporting health and care across Scotland. The successful supplier will act as prime contractor and provide a single point of accountability for end-to-end service delivery, integration and performance. The supplier will also be responsible for the management of any subcontractors and dependencies with other providers and Authority teams. The initial priority will be to maintain continuity and stabilise these business-critical services as they transition away from the existing National IT Contract, while establishing a strong foundation for subsequent improvement and modernisation. Lot 1: . PSD Scotland intends to procure a Service Integration and Management contract for selected national digital services supporting clinical, operational and administrative functions across NHS Scotland. The procurement will establish replacement arrangements for services currently delivered under the National IT Contract, which is due to expire on 31 March 2028. The principal objective is to maintain uninterrupted delivery of these business-critical services throughout transition and thereafter. The anticipated scope includes services and applications supporting Primary and Community Care, National Screening and Child Health, together with other services confirmed in the procurement documents. Depending on the requirements of each service, the contract may include application support, maintenance and development, as well as the associated infrastructure, platform, integrations and data services. IT Service Management capabilities are also required for end-to-end operation. The detailed application scope, service boundaries and allocation of responsibilities will be defined in the tender documentation. The successful supplier will act as the prime contractor, providing a single point of accountability for the contract. The supplier will be expected to coordinate its subcontractors and work effectively with the Authority’s retained teams and other internal and external providers. Service continuity will take precedence during the initial transition, followed by stabilisation to address supportability, resilience, cyber security, regulatory compliance and technical-debt risks. Once services have been stabilised, the supplier will support proportionate and staged modernisation through software and infrastructure engineering practices. Intended outcomes include: -Secure, compliant and resilient services -Clear and measurable service performance -Visibility of costs and dependencies -Improved value for money The supplier will also be expected to support knowledge transfer, effective service ownership, data portability and robust exit arrangements, reducing long-term supplier dependency and preserving future competition. The Authority will retain accountability for strategic direction, governance, business outcomes and service ownership throughout the contract.

sig_fcc71d539d8b0e2b6386.description: Tämä ei ole hankintailmoitus eikä tarjouspyyntö, vaan kutsu markkinavuoropuheluun, jolla Kaarinan kaupunki kartoittaa markkinoita varhaiskasvatuksen avoimen lähdekoodin eVaka-järjestelmän käyttöönotto-, ylläpito-, tuki- ja kehityspalvelujen kilpailutusta varten. KUTSU MARKKINAVUOROPUHELUUN Tämän markkinavuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinoilla olevia toimijoita sekä kerätä toimittajien kommentteja. Tavoitteena on saada kattavasti tietoa mahdollisen tulevan kilpailutuksen toteutuksen tueksi. Hankinnan kohde ja sisältö tarkentuu ja määritetään lopulliseen julkaistavaan tarjouspyyntöön. Tällä kutsulla pyydämme hankinnasta kiinnostuneita tarjoajia ilmoittautumaan ja osallistumaan hankintaa koskevaan vuoropuheluun. Vuoropuhelulla haetaan tietoa markkinoilla toimivista tarjoajista ja tarjolla olevien palveluiden ominaisuuksista suhteessa tilaajan tarpeisiin. Tavoitteena on saada palautetta sekä mahdollisia kehitysehdotuksia valmisteilla olevaan tarjouspyyntökokonaisuuteen. Markkinavuoropuhelu Markkinavuoropuhelut toteutetaan alustavan aikataulun mukaisesti ti 22.9.2026 klo 12-14 välisenä aikana etäyhteydellä Teams-kokouksena. Keskustelutilaisuudet järjestetään enintään kolmen (3) toimittajan kanssa. Mikäli markkinavuoropuheluun ilmoittautuneita yrityksiä on yli kolme (3), valitsee hankintayksikkö omista lähtökohdistaan sopivimmat toimittajat vuoropuheluun. Markkinavuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on tiedottaa markkinoita tulevasta kilpailutuksesta, kartoittaa markkinoiden tilannetta, mahdollistaa kommenttien esittäminen tulevasta hankinnasta sekä saada hankintaa koskevaa tietoa, jotta varsinainen tarjouskilpailu voidaan toteuttaa mahdollisimman tarkoituksenmukaisella tavalla. Markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuudessa esitellään tulevan hankinnan tarkoitus ja tavoitteet sekä yleisesti hankintaprosessi aikatauluineen (ei sitova). Hankintayksikkö varaa oikeuden toimittaa ilmoittautuneille ennakkokysymyksiä sekä luonnoksen tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoista ennen tilaisuutta. Nämä materiaalit käydään yhdessä läpi tilaisuuden aikana. Toimittajia pyydetään valmistautumaan tilaisuuteen enintään 10 minuutin esityksellä, jossa esitellään yrityksen toiminta, keskeiset osaamisalueet sekä hankinnan kannalta tarkoituksenmukaiset palvelut. Tilaisuudessa toimittajilla on myös mahdollisuus esittää kysymyksiä sekä tehdä ehdotuksia hankintaan liittyen. Markkinavuoropuhelu tullaan toteuttamaan suomen kielellä. Vuoropuheluun osallistumisesta ei makseta korvausta eikä hankintayksikkö korvaa markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumiseen aiheutuvista kustannuksista. ILMOITTAUTUMINEN Kaikkia kiinnostuneita alan toimijoita pyydetään ilmoittautumaan markkinavuoropuheluun viimeistään 15.9.2026 klo 11.00 mennessä osoitteessa https://kaarina.toimittajapalvelu.fi/ Ilmoittautumista koskevat lisätiedot: hankinnat@kaarina.fi ILMOITUKSEN LISÄTIEDOT Tämä ilmoitus on kutsu markkinavuoropuheluun. Tällä ilmoituksella ei pyydetä tarjouksia. Tämä ilmoitus ei velvoita hankintayksikköä toteuttamaan varsinaista hankintaa, eikä hankintayksikkö sitoudu tekemään tämän ilmoituksen mukaisia hankintoja. Ilmoitetut tiedot hankinnasta tai hankintamenettelystä eivät ole hankintayksikköä sitovia mahdollisessa myöhemmässä hankintamenettelyssä. Tähän markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumatta jättäminen ei estä mahdolliseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumista, eikä vuoropuheluun osallistuminen vaikuta tarjoajan asemaan varsinaisessa tarjouskilpailussa. Markkinavuoropuhelussa esiin tulleet tiedot säilyvät täysin luottamuksellisina ja niitä tullaan käyttämään ainoastaan mahdollisen hankinnan kehittämiseen ja suunnitteluun. Hankintayksikkö ei kuitenkaan ole velvollinen ottamaan huomioon markkinavuoropuhelussa saatuja vastauksia tarjouspyynnön laadinnassa.

sig_fded948ea627b084551a.description: The U.S. National Science Foundation Directorate for Engineering (NSF ENG) supports foundational research for electrical, communications and computing systems through the following programs: The Electronic, Photonic, Magnetic, and Quantum Devices (EPMQD) program supports foundational engineering research on novel classical and quantum devices, exploring matter’s electronic, photonic, and magnetic properties to enable new applications. The Circuits and Systems for Communications and Sensing (CSCS) program supports foundational engineering research on classical and quantum aspects of advanced components, systems, and signal processing for communications and sensing. The Energy, Power, Control, and Learning (EPCL) program supports foundational research on systems and control, learning, optimization, artificial intelligence, and networked multi-agent systems, and their applications, with emphasis on power and energy systems. NSF ENG anticipates a portfolio of ENG: Electrical, Communications, and Computing Systems (ECCS) awards with a range of budgets and durations. Estimated program budget, number of awards, and average award size/duration are subject to the availability of funds. NSF ENG is particularly interested in intellectually ambitious and potentially transformative foundational research. Proposals need not promise a near-term product, deployment, or commercial outcome, nor need they address later-stage development to be competitive.

sig_ff3c850c0e17fb4a43eb.description: With this RFI Yle invites interested suppliers to participate in the market dialogue held prior publishing the call for tenders (RFQ). Supplier should provide real-time HTML5 based graphics solutions in following areas: A) On screen, i.e. “lower third” graphics B) Full screen graphics C) Background videowall graphics D) Graphics controller In this RFI, Yle is not looking for augmented reality or virtual reality production solutions, otherwise known as AR, XR or VR systems. Parts A, B, C, and D can be offered as a single solution or independently of each other. This means, Yle is not necessarily looking for a company-wide solution; a solution for a single part (A,B,C,D) may turn out to be a reasonable solution. If not all parts are offered, a recommendation of compatible other solutions / products that fill in the missing parts is required. The offered solution for parts A, B, C, or D should be capable of serving Yle’s production environment. The entirety of it consists of 12 tv studios, 3 OB trucks, 1 playout centre and roughly dozen cloud live streaming units. Current graphic device count is roughly 200 devices, 50 real-time rendering servers and 6 non linear editing (NLE) rendering servers. Content filling clients have around 1300 installations. In this RFI, Yle is looking to identify the solutions available in the market that could meet Yle’s needs. In the RFI process, Yle may schedule meetings with a few chosen suppliers. If possible, setting up a hands-on test environment with key features of the system, would be helpful for better understanding. Please find the list of basic components for each part A-D as well as the detailed description of the object of the procurement in the document "RFI - Real-time HTML5 Graphics System". You can find the document in tender portal (https://tarjouspalvelu.fi/yleisradiooy?id=585018&tpk=7d09db49-a4a7-443a-9948-ce0fb71ab59f) or contacting tarjoukset.yle(at)yle.fi. Kindly note that in this RFI, Yle has specified the need for real-time graphic system(s), as previously described in the RFI for Real-time Graphics Systems. INTERESTED? Interested suppliers are invited to take part in the market dialogue by sending a request to participate by email to tarjoukset.yle(at)yle.fi at latest by 5th of December 2025. In case you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact us. Please include a description or additional appendices covering the following topics in your email: 1) Description of the solution you provide, including a description of which key features are included in your solution 2) A short company presentation, including the size of the company in terms of revenue and number of employees. 3) Your previous experience and few appropriate reference cases. 4) Reference architecture view 5) Description of your licence and pricing model 6) Description of your cyber security policies and continuity planning 7) Description of your GDPR policies We look forward to your replies. We will review the answers as soon as they are received. In case Yle decides to have meetings or short discussions with a few suppliers, we’ll thrive to send the invitations during January 2026 at the latest. The agenda will focus on how your solution could fit our needs.
sig_ff3c850c0e17fb4a43eb.title: RFI / Real-time HTML5 Graphics System

sig_ff40808955fe25e4dd40.description: Karmøy municipality intends to publish a procurement on an electronic patient journal system (EPJ) for two doctor offices: Bygnes and Skudenes. It is desirable for the contracting authority that if this occurs, prices can be obtained from the chosen tenderer. In this context, we would like to announce a draft of the competition for a hearing in order to get feedback from the supplier market before the final announcement. The documents we would like feedback on are the SSA annex (requirement, price model) and the tender documentation. We mainly want written feedback, but there will also be an option to arrange a meeting for review. If a meeting is wanted, please notify us via the communication module. The deadline for submitting feedback is 31.10.2025

sig_ff8af9c98908e0397ac6.description: Oulun kaupunki requests tenders for the procurement of passenger counting devices for Oulu region transport and related installation, maintenance and support services. The subject of the procurement is the supply of passenger counting devices to be installed in the public transport fleet of Oulu region transport (OSL), as well as related installation, maintenance, support and reporting services. The procurement includes the collection, transfer and reporting of passenger count data for the contracting authority's use in accordance with the invitation to tender and contract documents. The objective is to produce reliable passenger data to support the planning, monitoring and development of public transport. In the first phase of the procurement, passenger counting devices will be installed in 40 three-door BYD electric buses of Oulu region transport. During the contract period, the contracting authority may expand the use of the system to other vehicles in accordance with the terms of the invitation to tender and the contract.
sig_ff8af9c98908e0397ac6.title: Procurement of passenger counting devices and related installation, maintenance and support services

sig_ffca1b8fec1781953c67.description: The tender process comprises the conclusion of one (1) contract regarding the Contracting Authority's procurement of the development of an AI-based simulation tool for training child interviews. Based on this tender, one (1) joint contract will be concluded between the supplier and the Responsible Contracting Authority, cf. point 1.2 of the tender conditions, which acts on behalf of all participating contracting authorities. The Responsible Contracting Authority is Professionshøjskolen Absalon, which is authorised to manage all rights and obligations under the contract and acts as the contracting party towards the supplier. The supplier may therefore only direct claims against the Responsible Contracting Authority. Other participating contracting authorities are not direct contracting parties and are not liable either individually or jointly for the performance of the contract. Professionshøjskolen Absalon, in collaboration with the other university colleges, Red Barnet, Barndom Uden Vold and Ole Kirk’s Fond, is offering a contract for the development of an AI-based simulation tool, which is referred to in the tender documentation as the Solution. The purpose is to strengthen the competencies of social workers and social work students to conduct interviews with children in vulnerable situations, including children who may have been exposed to violence or abuse. The Solution must create a realistic, safe and learning-oriented training environment where users can prepare for child interviews, conduct interviews with digital avatars, receive guidance and feedback from a Tutor and subsequently analyse their interviews for the purpose of learning and reflection. It must be capable of being used in social work education, in continuing and further education programmes and in municipal practice. The first version, which this tender covers, must provide the possibility for speech- and text-based interaction with four avatars aged 9–11 years, representing different backgrounds and case types. In addition, there is a Tutor who supports the user before, during and after the interview through preparatory information, ongoing professional hints and subsequent debriefing. The Solution must accommodate both full interview processes and shorter modules where individual interview techniques can be trained in isolation. In the long term, the ambition is to expand the solution with more advanced modalities such as facial expressions and body language as well as real-time analysis of non-verbal communication. The Contracting Authority therefore wishes to attract suppliers who can not only deliver the tendered solution but can also think visionarily in terms of creating a future-proof and innovative platform. The Responsible Contracting Authority provides an extensive knowledge base in the form of practice-oriented cases, anonymised child interviews and the expertise of professionals, and will also contribute actively with professional sparring during development. The tenders will be evaluated on feasibility and risk assessment, functionality and security, the realism of the avatars, the professional quality of the tutor as well as the overall user experience and technical robustness. The Responsible Contracting Authority is entitled to terminate the contract at Partial Delivery Day 1 (POC), solely for the purpose of bringing the project to an end, if it turns out during Partial Delivery 1 - POC that there are technical challenges which make it impossible to develop a suitable and usable Solution for the purpose that the contract supports, cf. point 31.2.1 of the Contract. However, it is the clear intention of the Responsible Contracting Authority to complete the development of a complete Solution that functions according to its purpose. Due to the established budget, the Contracting Authority has set a price ceiling for the Delivery Consideration. The Delivery Consideration, including the price for the Clarification Phase and the Delivery, cf. Contract Annex 01 – Schedule, must thus be a maximum of five (5) million DKK excl. VAT. Within the established price ceiling of five (5) million DKK excl. VAT, the Contracting Authority wishes to promote solutions that combine high technical quality and a high level of innovation. With this tender, the Contracting Authority aims to support a competition that is not only based on price, but also on the Tenderers' ability to think long-term and visionarily. The Contracting Authority therefore explains the strategic and technological ambitions for the Solution in order to encourage tenderers to present proposals that reflect a future-proof and technologically advanced approach. At the same time, it is important for the Contracting Authority that the Solution can be operated sustainably within the financial frameworks that apply to the joint operations of the university colleges. The Contracting Authority therefore wishes to enter into a contract with a Supplier who can ensure creativity and technical ingenuity in relation to developing a Solution that meets the desired needs, but which can at the same time be operated by the university colleges jointly - where interview flow is weighted higher than visualisation of the child's non-verbal language.
sig_ffca1b8fec1781953c67.title: Tender with negotiation regarding the development of an AI-based simulation tool for training in child interviews

sig_fff523f025a34927918a.description: TRANSQ is a joint qualification system for suppliers and contractors to leading Scandinavian aviation, postal, rail and transport utilities. It's operated by Achilles under Article 77 of Directive 2014/25/EU. The subscribing utilities will use TRANSQ for tenderer selection for contracts and framework agreements subject to EU procurement rules but reserve the right to publish individual notices for specific requirements where they deem it necessary, even though they relate to the product and service categories covered by TRANSQ. At each subscriber's discretion, the qualification system may be used for contracts not subject to EU procurement rules, and/or the subscriber can choose to also apply the qualification system Utilities NCE where the qualification requirements correspond to TRANSQ. An overview of products and services acquired through TRANSQ is available here https://www.achilles.com/app/uploads/2023/05/Achilles-TransQ-Nordics-Codes-En.pdf
